Package com.hkust.marketplace.utils

Class NotificationStore

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.utils.NotificationStore
public class NotificationStore extends Object
Notification board, one list shared by all recipients. Every notification is saved to the notifications table when it is added, and its read flag by markRead(com.hkust.marketplace.models.Notification, boolean); load() rebuilds them at startup.
